tenderSchedule.title: Inviting Short Term Tender to Provide Face Recognition Services during examination being conducted by the Karnataka Public Service Commission
tenderSchedule.description: Inviting Short Term Tender to Provide Face Recognition Services during examination being conducted by the Karnataka Public Service Commission.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and conditions are as per the tender doucoment

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The agencies should have directly executed the work for Central / State Government /PSU/Government Institutions for handling similar activities of providing Face Recognition Services during online/offline examination for Minimum 3 customers in last 05 years.
Average annual turnover of the company should not be less than Rs. 3 Cr., in the last 3 financial years of providing Security Ancillary Services during the Examination

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have executed the similar work (Face Recognition) for a value not less than Rs.25 Lakhs in single/multiple orders out of which each work order should not be less than Rs.5 Lakhs during the preceding 5 years 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26,

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not have been debarred/ blacklisted by any Organization/ Board/ Council/ University/ Commission and any other Government/ PSU / Government undertaking organization.
The bidder should be a company registered under the Companies Act, 1956/2013 or a Partnership firm established as per law.
All Other Relevant Documents as per the technical Bid Documents

itemList.itemName: Charges per Candidate per session for Multiple Session Examination spreading up to a week or more. (Impersonation control through Facial recognition of candidate by verifying Candidates identity on real-time basis.)
Charges per Candidate per session for Three Session Examination across two days. (Impersonation control through Facial recognition of candidate by verifying Candidates identity on real-time basis.)
Charges per Candidate per session for One day Two Session Examination.(Impersonation control through Facial recognition of candidate by verifying Candidates identity on real-time basis.)
Charges per Candidate per session for Single Session Examination. (Impersonation control through Facial recognition of candidate by verifying Candidates identity on real-time basis.)
